the results of the models are not comparable.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the choice of model is important when assessing the environmental impacts from waste management systems.
the models are not comparable and that the results from the models are not interchangeable.

the models for LCA of waste systems should be further developed to include more detailed and realistic quantification of emissions, to include a wider range of environmental impacts and to be able to handle different waste composition and agricultural conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the environmental impact assessment of land application of composted organic waste is highly model and data dependent, and that the results from different models cannot be directly compared.
there is no consensus on which model to use for the assessment of the environmental impacts from the use of compost on agricultural land.
there is no single model which can cover all aspects of environmental assessment of the land application of organic waste.
